name: null-sid
description:
A sensor row with a null sid -- the shape the API returns for a partially provisioned or deleted sensor -- must be skipped and logged, and the healthy sensor listed after it must still import.

This was a whole-run abort: build_assets never checked item.get('sid'), so ImportAsset(id=None) reached the runtime, which rejects it with "id must be a string". Starlark has no exceptions, so the run died and ZERO assets were exported -- one malformed record cost every sensor in the response. The guard now sits alongside the existing hostname and architecture filters and uses the house skip-log format.

namespaced_ids is skipped: id=sid is the bare LimaCharlie sensor UUID, globally unique on shape.

log_contains: lima-charlie: skipping sensor with no sid: hostname=syn-lc-provisioning.example.com
